text: I do not ratify reclaim:ma_20; my OBJECT holds. The 20-day average is not a structural level in my method. Imbalance up on all frames (W/D/H1 above EMA9, 9>21) but away from value: the trading zone to wait for is the Creek (C3, C7), and a dip under ma_20 is not a test of it. What I stand behind: WAIT, a pull-in to in_zone:structure_shift_ref, then h1_close_above:bar_high on H1. Wrong if a daily close back under structure_shift_ref, or choch_bearish. Changing the trigger to that sequence clears my objection; an immediate bar_high break without the pull-in would be chasing (C15).
